description_zh: Zoox 车辆（ego）在交叉口左转，对向车（v2）闯 stop sign 直行，撞击 ego 左后侧。选择 ego 进行左转决策测试，control 设为 stop_sign 以反映违规直行冲突。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle was in manual mode making a left turn from Lemon St. onto Oakdell St.
A passenger vehicle passed through a stop sign without slowing and made contact with the rear and left side of the Zoox vehicle.
Vehicle 1 Movement Preceding Collision: E. MAKING LEFT TURN
evidence.reason: 双方均为移动车辆，存在左转 vs 闯 stop 直行的路口冲突，可用 junction_cross 表达对向车行为，stop_sign 控制违规。天气、时间明确可填。
